_evidence: Gate overlay for 0x004431cf, composed AFTER the 0x4097c7 chain layouts (the 0x408c3e list + state_00431ffb + start_004098fd) and the gate callee layouts. 0x51f1d4 -> 0x520023: with byte [0x7ad8b2] == 0xff it counts the bytes of the 22-entry car-number table 0x7c2a48 with bit 7 set (the flagged cars 0x520054 copies into the list 0x66d8f4) and returns CF=1 for two or more, which makes 0x4431cf exit ('jb' at 0x4431e7; image: 0x7ad8b2 = 0, table 1..22 unflagged, so CF was always 0): [0x7ad8b2] draws {0xff,0,1,2} and each table byte keeps its car number k (1..22, as in the image) with bit 7 set in a third of the draws (k or k|0x80: the 0x409b17/0x408f1c key searches of the chain then miss a flagged entry and fall back to index 0, no fault). 0x4431b3 is the 16-bit LCG word [0x66d8c4] (x*5, (x>>2)&0x3f gives the list index; static image 0x11 gave index 21 every time): any u16. 'cmp ax,[0x66d8f0]; jge' compares the 0..22 active-car count of 0x44303b with a signed word limit: drawn 0..40 so both outcomes occur. [0x66d8ec] is the car-list length (order_00675958: 2..22, the sort helper never ends below 2): the 0..63 index is compared with it (jge). Per-car counter bytes [((code & 0x3f)-1) + 0x66ec4a] (code from the list 0x66d8f4, list_00443278 values give indices -1..21 and 62) are counts_0066ec49's run-time counters, here over 0x66ec49..0x66ec88; [0x7c2e98] is the signed limit they are compared with after +2 (jge): 0..300 so both outcomes occur. Byte [0x7c2ea9] == 0x44 (cmp; jne) selects the 0x4432db check: drawn {0x44,0x44,0x80,0,0x40} (the chain's own layouts never drew 0x44). 0x43b920 scans car +0x7a bit 7 from car 1 or 2 ([0x7aafd4] 0..1): state_0043b920's bit_scan pattern is reapplied last so the no-free-car (stc) exit is reached; random bytes elsewhere in the car records come from cars_0066fef0 as before. To reach the deep gates in more cases (each gate exits on one side): byte [0x7c2e75] (cmp 0; je - nonzero exits at once; the chain then runs only its 0x4097fd path, as in the game when this check passes) draws {0,0,0,1}, and the unsigned threshold [0x62d238] of 'cmp [0x66d8cc]; jb' draws {0,0,0,1,0xffffffff} against the fuzzed [0x66d8cc] (0 never below, 0xffffffff almost always). Funnel biasing (all values inside the domains the chain layouts already draw): the LCG word [0x66d8c4] draws seeds whose index ((x*5)>>2)&0x3f is 0,1,2,3,5,12,16,21,63,... and the list length [0x66d8ec] {22,22,20,16,8,2}, so 'cmp eax,[0x66d8ec]; jge' goes both ways often; flag bytes 0x66d909..0x66d91f {0,0,0,1,0x40,0x80,0xff} (bit 7 exits at 0x443242). The no-free-car exit of 0x43b920 (every car +0x7a bit 7 clear, bit_scan all-clear mode) needs 0x44303b's active count (cars with +0x7a bit 7 clear minus those whose removal is due: +0x8d bit 6, +0xff bit 6, +0xf0 != 0 and [0x66d814]-[+0xf0] >= 0, which call 0x408742 instead of counting) below 14 and below [0x66d8f0]: car bytes +0x8d (0x66ff7d) {0x40,0x42,0xc0,0xff,0x40,0}, +0xff (0x66ffef) {0x40,0xff,0x40,0}, due times +0xf0 (0x66ffe0) {1,1,1000,0} and the clock [0x66d814] {0x7ffffff0, 0x10000, 1000, 0} (0 makes no car due, so the count >= 14 exit still occurs) make many cars due in most draws (plain flag/time values, as cars_004436f9/flags_00408f7b, no fault).
